title: EduNext Parent, Teacher & Management
description: A suite of school apps for parents and students, teachers, and school leadership across multiple branches.
highlights: Parent (1M+ users): dashboard redesign, homework, timetable, calendar, gallery, quiz, library, screenshot protection.
Teacher: built requisition and transport communication end-to-end; lead the app's support and releases.
Management: top contributor — finance modules, payroll, grievances, and 20+ analytics screens.

title: Face-Recognition Attendance
description: Selfie-based attendance for teachers, running fully on the device inside the React Native app.
highlights: Kotlin native module using ML Kit face detection and a TensorFlow Lite MobileFaceNet model for face embeddings.
Geofenced check-in using live location against a school radius.
Fixed out-of-memory crashes on low-end phones with lazy model loading and image downscaling.

title: Report & Template Builder
description: A drag-and-drop canvas editor for report cards, certificates, receipts, and ID cards, with a PDF rendering service.
highlights: Canvas-to-Handlebars export engine with data binding, conditional logic, repeating table rows, charts, QR codes, and barcodes.
AI template generation with the Gemini vision API — upload a document image, get an editable template.
Node.js + Puppeteer PDF service: custom Handlebars helpers, multi-copy PDFs, font embedding, ZIP / AWS S3 export.

title: SimplyAdmission
description: An admission-management app that runs a school's full admission funnel.
highlights: Covers enquiries, form sales, counsellor meetings, school tours, admissions, and lead tracking.
Reusable components, dynamic forms, and filters in a modular architecture.
